status: Owner-requested locked working baseline; limited lab, not production completion
owner_authority: Chat 2026-10-07: summarize all character design in the repository and lock the achieved settings

active_lab.runtime: Godot 4.7.2 / browser Canvas; no production engine selected

walking.frame_order: 0..7 horizontal, authored source 4 columns x 2 rows, row-major
walking.swap_policy: Keep frame and clock while swapping equipment; no procedural knee/limb deformation

blink.method: Clip the existing closed-eye artwork into ocular regions only; preserve each selected expression's eyebrows and mouth. Use the shared head transform.
blink.reference: research/DDTank41-Classic/Source Flash/scripts/ddt/view/character/RoomPlayerAction.as: NORMAL_CLOSE_EYES (open -> closed -> open); lab timing is independent of walking.

icons.eye_inventory_policy: One open-eye icon per eye set; closed-eye source only in animation_faces

category_status.hair: implemented brown + paired blue, A/B cap coverage
category_status.face: implemented two eye+brow+mouth sets with independent blink
category_status.cloth: implemented two complete headless bodies, separate stand and eight walk frames
category_status.head: implemented one cap / none
category_status.glass: original DDTank compositor implemented; new-character slot not integrated
category_status.wing: original SWF-to-atlas compositor implemented; 128 verified pairs, custom lab UI does not expose a new wing slot
category_status.suits: original full-suit replacement implemented; custom full-costume asset and pose family not integrated
category_status.arm: original compositor has default weapon proxy for aura level; new walking weapon/socket/actions not integrated

aura.lab_tier4: tier3 hue variant, scale 1.1; no original SWF tier4

native_compatibility.rule: Original show/game/virtual layouts remain canonical; stand_show and walk_downleft are explicit lab extensions; not 100% Flash interchange

authoring_rules: Keep one immutable blank head and body proportion template. No per-item runtime fitting, trim, stretch or geometry replacement.
Hair pair: first standard blank head + new hair, without eyes/brows/mouth; then matching hair-only RGBA via ImageGen. Preserve both raw outputs and prompts; only hair-only is a compositing layer.
Eye sets own eyes, brows and mouth and originate from hairless sources; eff owns scars/tattoos/earrings/details on the same head.
Clothing sources must be authored headless with intact rounded neck, collar, scarf, hands, legs and shoes. Never cut a headed portrait to manufacture a body.

Head layers share scale 0.23 and source/target anchors. Existing two walk families have distinct recorded offline scales/neck tables; freeze these historical calibrations, not a permission to fit future items arbitrarily.
New looks must match viewpoint, head coverage, neck overlap and feet support in every authored pose; dimension/hash checks alone do not approve art.
Full costume is a replacement mode, not an extra overlapping normal head/body; requires a complete supported pose family.
release_limits: Only male downleft custom walk and stand are implemented. Eight directions, female family, run, gun/sword/actions and full costumes remain unsupported.
Static head parts are shared across eight body frames, not a skeletal rig.
Not integrated into the main v0.1 playable, RPGJS or Phaser production runtime.
No proof of production throughput for thousands of assets.
change_policy: Preserve v1 byte-for-byte. Any authorized revision gets a new version plus visual/registration tests; never regenerate the v1 lock just to silence a failure.
